Daily Panchang Details for November 1, 2026: Ahoi Ashtami Vrat and Muhurat Timings

Daily Panchang Overview

According to the reported details for November 1, 2026, the calendar features the observance of the Ahoi Ashtami Vrat. The information outlines specific timings for lunar days, constellations, and astrological periods for the day.

Tithi and Nakshatra Timings

  • Tithi: The Kartik Krishna Saptami tithi remains in effect until 02:51 PM, after which the Ashtami tithi begins.
  • Nakshatra: Pushya nakshatra continues until early morning at 04:30 AM on November 2, following which Ashlesha nakshatra takes over.
  • Yoga: Sadhya yoga lasts until 02:51 PM, leading into the commencement of Shubh yoga.
  • Moon Sign: The Moon remains positioned in Cancer (Karka rashi) throughout the day and night.

Auspicious and Inauspicious Timings

  • Abhijit Muhurat: Scheduled from 11:42 AM to 12:27 PM.
  • Amrit Kaal: Expected from 10:25 PM to 11:56 PM.
  • Rahu Kaal: Reported from 05:30 PM to 07:00 PM.
  • Gulik Kaal: Listed from 03:30 PM to 05:00 PM.
  • Yamagandam: Occurs from 12:00 PM to 01:30 PM.

Verification and Practical Implications

Readers interested in observing the Ahoi Ashtami fast or planning rituals should verify these timings against local calendar computations and traditional almanacs. Specific regional variations and sunrise-sunset times can influence exact muhurat durations.
